proposals.framework_name: Elliot v0.3.1 reproducible recommender evaluation suite
proposals.dataset_release_id: MovieLens 1M stable release 2003-02; ml-1m.zip; provider-published MD5 sidecar

benchmark_target_summary.dataset_split: MovieLens 1M converted from ratings.dat to dataset.tsv; iterative 10-core prefilter; 20% random-subsampling test split; 5-fold random-cross-validation validation split
benchmark_target_summary.method_config: BPRMF under the source-owned advanced_configuration.yml; five random hyperparameter evaluations; 50 epochs; the exact learning-rate, batch-size and regularization search spaces are pinned in the config
protocol_caveats: The numeric target is Table 3 of the Elliot SIGIR 2021 paper and is only a future reference-reproduction target.
The random holdout/CV protocol, relevance threshold and nDCG@50 are not comparable to the v5 temporal novel-purchase full-catalog protocol.
FD3 must replay the v0.3.1 defaults, random-state behavior and selected hyperparameter realization before materialization.

proposals.task_family: top-N recommendation evaluation over timestamped explicit ratings converted to Elliot's user-item-rating-timestamp TSV surface

proposals.dataset_release_id: MovieLens 1M stable release 2003-02; ml-1m.zip; provider-published MD5 sidecar

benchmark_target_summary.dataset_split: MovieLens 1M origin view; global time-aware split-by-ratio with rho=80%; latest 10% of training held out for validation
benchmark_target_summary.method_config: BPRMF with original BPR objective, uniform negative sampler and 30 Bayesian HyperOpt trials optimized on NDCG@10; best TSBR hyperparameters are source-owned in appendix Tables 16-18
protocol_caveats: The target is the DaisyRec-owned TSBR ranking-result surface for BPRMF on the unfiltered origin view.
The suite reports multiple metrics and cutoffs; this proposal freezes only NDCG@10 = 0.5275 as the reference target.
TSBR preprocessing, negative sampling and evaluator semantics differ from v5 and cannot support direct cross-dataset comparison.
